Ratsputin's Frosted Forest Snow Globe Ring
Piece:  Ring
Defense Rating:  varies with item level

Ratsputin's Frosted Forest Snow Globe Ring is a ring.

It is unknown how many different varieties of this particular mythic item exist. Some of the Mythic items in this series may have the same name but different attributes.

Attributes:

The base item always carries:

  • + Agility
  • + Endurance
  • + Defense Rating
  • + Ranged Attack Rating
  • + Ice Damage Resistance
  • + Ranged Damage

Rolled copies can also pick up an extra ending. Those endings and their bonuses are listed on Mythic Suffixes.
